KeysToEntries.Intro_Shaman_1_NotStarted: The Moon Sprites tell me that you are the one: the one prophesied to map the Umbral Sands.
KeysToEntries.Intro_Shaman_2_NotStarted: While I am old, this clan is young. They may live in the Sands, but this clan does not understand it.
KeysToEntries.Intro_Shaman_3_NotStarted: The Moon Sprites have a task for you. Travel to the top of tall and rocky locations around this camp. There, some Sprites will be waiting for you.
KeysToEntries.Intro_Shaman_4_NotStarted: Use the Moon Sprites' power of echolocation to map the sands. Survey it. Then you will bring that knowledge back to me.
KeysToEntries.Intro_Shaman_Generic: The Moon Sprites see you, adventurer.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_1_NotComplete: The Moon Sprites await you on tall rocks and ruins around Alcarrid.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_2_NotComplete: They look much like fireflies. Look at the ones next to me to understand what you are looking for. And please: do not wait much longer before you find them all.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_1_DoneSprites: Young one, you have done it! The Moon Sprites have echolocated across our little corner of the Umbral Sands.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_2_DoneSprites: The next step is mine. I will use the information to make maps that can be distributed among the garou.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_3_DoneSprites: The Moon Sprites and I cannot thank you enough. While it may seem like a small task, it's benefit is immeasurable.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_4_DoneSprites: Take this reward. Return to me if you would consider mapping the rest of the Umbral Sands, not just around Alcarrid.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_QuestComplete: Peace to you, young one. The Moon Sprites are happy to see you.
KeysToEntries.Sprites_Found_1: The Moon Sprites have mapped this area! They wish to tell you a small story about what happened here...
KeysToEntries.Sprites_Found_Repeat: You have already found the Moon Sprites in this location. They repeat their story of what happened in this local region.
KeysToEntries.Sprites_Found_All: You have found all of the Moon Sprites! Return to Anamcara, the Moon Sprite Shaman, to give him the news.
KeysToEntries.QuestDesc: Discover Moon Sprites on top of tall locations around the Alcarrid Camp to map the Umbral Sands.
KeysToEntries.Objective1: Climb tall locations around the Alcarrid Camp and find their Moon Sprites
KeysToEntries.Objective2: Return to the Moon Sprite Shaman in the Alcarrid Camp
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite1_Lore_1: The KotHaar stacked these rocks, puk puk! They built them before there was a bully called Fuzan. The rocks are a KotHaar calendar.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite1_Lore_2: The KotHaar can tell how many months have passed from the erosion on the rocks. Very clever, puk puk!
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite2_Lore_1: Garou lived in these ruins once, puk puk. The garou were not so kind to the Moon Sprites. They not trust us, nor did they trust Fuzan.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite2_Lore_2: The garou who lived here did not submit to Fuzan. And you can see what happened to them, puk!
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite3_Lore1: Nearby is the Nightmare Crucible gate. That is not the name that Moon Sprites give it! Puk puk, it is the name given to it by an ancient race.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite3_Lore2: It is not a nice place. It sucks anima from the world like roots from a tree. You have Moon Sprite permission to destroy it.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprites_NotStarted_1: Talk to Anamcara, the Moon Sprite Shaman in Alcarrid, puk puk! He will tell you what to do with us.
KeysToEntries.Objective3: Climb tall locations near Alcarrid Camp and find their Moon Sprites (0/3)
KeysToEntries.Objective4: Climb tall locations near Alcarrid Camp and find their Moon Sprites (1/3)
KeysToEntries.Objective5: Climb tall locations near Alcarrid Camp and find their Moon Sprites (2/3)
KeysToEntries.Objective6: Climb tall locations near Alcarrid Camp and find their Moon Sprites (3/3)
KeysToEntries.DummyMoonSprite.NotStarted.1: Ooh a human! Not seen one in centuries. You will want to talk to the Moon Sprite Shaman, puk puk.
KeysToEntries.DummyMoonSprite.Started.1: If you're looking to map the area, you will want to be looking for Moon Sprites like us, puk puk. They will be slightly less handsome, though.
KeysToEntries.DummyMoonSprite.CompleteM1.1: You found us all! I bet the other Moon Sprites talked your ear off, didn't they?
KeysToEntries.DummyMoonSprite.CompleteM2.1: Congratulations on finding us all! It makes us dance with delight that we got to help the Moon Garou map the area, puk puk!
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_NoSpace: Ah, you have no room for the gift that we wish to give you. Come back when you have space.
